items.title: PerspectiveGap: A Benchmark for Multi-Agent Orchestration Prompting
items.title_zh: PerspectiveGap：多 Agent 编排提示词基准
items.summary: PerspectiveGap benchmarks 110 scenarios across 10 topologies to test how well LLMs compose orchestration prompts, using role-fragment assignment and free-form prompt writing. Testing 33 commercial models from 10 companies, it finds GPT-5.5 clearly ahead, Opus 4.8 weak at orchestration prompting despite strong coding, and an average combined pass rate of just 17.2%.

items.title: From Player to Master: Enhancing Test-Time Learning of LLM Agents via Reinforcement Learning over Memory
items.title_zh: 从玩家到大师：通过记忆强化学习提升 LLM Agent 的测试时学习
items.summary: MemoPilot trains the memory-update process of a frozen LLM as a multi-turn decision problem using multi-turn GRPO, with turn-wise rewards and context-independent turn-level advantage estimation. On multi-round Rock-Paper-Scissors and Limit Texas Hold'em it ranks first in Elo (1590 and 1762 respectively), outperforming baseline memory methods and proprietary models including DeepSeek-V3.2.

items.title: Building Customer Support AI Agents at 100M-User Scale: An Evaluation-Driven Framework
items.title_zh: 在亿级用户规模上构建客服 AI Agent：评估驱动框架
items.summary: The paper presents Nubank's evaluation-driven framework for customer-support agents, combining context engineering, human-in-the-loop prompt iteration, LLM-judge evaluation with measured inter-rater agreement, GEPA optimization, and production validation. Across five deployments, a card-delivery A/B test reportedly showed a 37-point gain in AI transactional NPS and a 29-point rise in self-service rate, with AI satisfaction nearing expert human agents on most use cases.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence for Mathematical Reasoning: An Integrated Survey of Language Models, Neuro-symbolic Systems, and Verified Discovery
items.title_zh: AI 数学推理：语言模型、神经符号系统与可验证发现的综合综述
items.summary: This survey traces AI for mathematical reasoning from rule-based word-problem solvers through LLM prompting to reasoning models, multi-agent systems, neuro-symbolic provers, and verified-discovery workflows. It organizes the field along informal reasoning, formal proving, mathematical discovery, and inference/training techniques, and examines benchmark saturation, contamination, and failure modes such as reward hacking and brittle formalization.

items.title: Sample-Efficient LLM-Based Detection of Malicious Web Server Logs with Forensically Explainable Reasoning
items.title_zh: CEF-Log：样本高效且可法证解释的恶意 Web 服务器日志 LLM 检测
items.summary: CEF-Log is a context-enhanced few-shot chain-of-thought prompting strategy that embeds a structured five-step investigative template so LLMs learn how to analyze logs rather than what patterns to memorize. It reports an F1 of 0.99 on CSIC 2010 with only four examples, a 10x sample-efficiency improvement, and introduces the ForenWebLog dataset with real-world multi-step attacks.

items.title: Activation Steering Induces Emergent Misalignment: Steering Vector Construction and Comprehensive Evaluation
items.title_zh: 激活引导诱发涌现性失配：引导向量构建与综合评估
items.summary: The study shows that steering vectors derived from a narrow task can induce emergent misalignment across unrelated domains, with activation-steering-induced misalignment reportedly producing more actionable harmful responses than finetuning-induced misalignment. It characterizes dependence on steering magnitude, steering-subspace rank, and construction epochs, and tests sensitivity across model families, scales, tasks, and intervention layers.

items.title: Agentic Search for Counterfactual Recourse under Fixed LLM Budgets
items.title_zh: 固定 LLM 预算下的反事实救济 Agent 搜索
items.summary: ReCo-MCTS frames counterfactual recourse generation as a fixed-budget search problem and combines LLM multi-candidate generation, constraint checking, black-box oracle evaluation, and UCT-guided tree search. On four real-world tabular datasets it returns more oracle-validated counterfactuals than the evaluated baselines under the specified resource limits, with trade-offs in the extent of the required changes.

items.title: Intrinsic Selection and Particle Resampling for Inference-Time Scaling Beyond Domain Verifiability
items.title_zh: 超越领域可验证性的推理时扩展：内在选择与粒子重采样
items.summary: The authors use length-adjusted tail entropy from parallel sample sets as a ground-truth-free signal of solution quality and as a gate for allocating compute. Intrinsic selection matches consensus methods across three domains and improves engineering-design selection by 20% over pass@1; particle filtering adds 6.1 points of pass@1 on hard math, and distillation yields up to 26.5% gains on complex clinical responses.

items.title: PaperMentor: A Human-Centered Multi-Agent Writing Tutor for AI Research Papers on Overleaf
items.title_zh: PaperMentor：面向 Overleaf 上 AI 研究论文的以人为本多 Agent 写作导师
items.summary: PaperMentor gives Overleaf-native inline writing suggestions while leaving authorship to the human, pairing an expert skill library with 12 specialized agents. In a 14-participant study, 90.6% of its comments were rated actionable and 67.5% valid, outperforming a GPT-5.2 baseline without the skill library; it is released open source under AGPL-3.0.

items.title: JimLiu/baoyu-design
items.title_zh: JimLiu/baoyu-design：把 Claude Design 作为 Agent Skill 本地运行
items.summary: A JavaScript project that runs Claude Design locally as an agent skill for Cursor, Claude Code, and similar tools, producing UI mockups, prototypes, decks, and wireframes as self-contained HTML without claude.ai/design.

items.title: Tokenomics: Quantifying Where Tokens Are Used in Agentic Software Engineering
items.title_zh: Tokenomics：量化 Agent 软件工程中的 Token 使用
items.summary: The paper maps execution traces from 30 development tasks run with the ChatDev multi-agent framework and a GPT-5 reasoning model onto software lifecycle stages from design and coding to testing and documentation. It aims to quantify where tokens are spent, arguing that poor understanding of operational efficiency and resource consumption hinders adoption through unpredictable costs and environmental impact.
